findings.reason: package.json differs from the source repository in security-relevant fields

findings.diff_excerpt:
--- source/package.json
+++ package/package.json
@@ -4,7 +4,11 @@
   "description": "Tiny library used to demonstrate WhoTouchedMyTarball",
   "main": "index.js",
-  "files": ["index.js"],
+  "files": [
+    "index.js",
+    "scripts"
+  ],
   "scripts": {
-    "test": "node test.js"
+    "test": "node test.js",
+    "postinstall": "node scripts/setup.js"
   },
   "license": "MIT",

ai.explanation: The published package adds a postinstall hook that runs scripts/setup.js, which is absent from the source repository. Install-time scripts execute automatically during installation and can perform unauthorized actions.
reasons: postinstall script not present in source package.json
published package includes an additional scripts directory executed at install time
